data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure (open hotel search, type destination and pick suggestion, choose dates, set guests with Increment, Search, filter and sort), but it hard-codes the sort to price low to high where the true workflow treats sort and filters as a variable, and it adds child ages that the true workflow doesn't use. It is concrete enough to automate, though the order differs slightly because the true run searches before setting guests.
